# Sirach Chapter 23 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 23 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**23:1** O-LORD, Father and Master of-my-life, do-not-abandon me to-their-counsel; do-not-let-me-fall because-of them.

**23:2** Who will-set stripes over my-thought, and the-discipline of-wisdom over my-heart, in-order-that they-spare-me-not my-ignorances and they-pass-not-over my-sins?

**23:3** Lest my-ignorances be-multiplied and my-sins abound and I-fall before-the-eyes of my-adversaries and my-enemy rejoice over-me.

**23:4** O-LORD, Father and God of-my-life, do-not-give to-me a-haughty-look, and desire — turn-it-away from-me.

**23:5** Let-not the-desire-of-the-belly and of-intercourse seize-hold-of me, and do-not-give-me over to a-shameless-soul.

**23:6** Give-ear, children, to-the-discipline of-the-mouth; and the-one-who-keeps it will-not-be-caught.

**23:7** In-his-sins the-sinner is-trapped; and the-proud-man and the-blasphemer will-stumble among them.

**23:8** Do-not-accustom your-mouth to an-oath, and do-not-make-a-habit of-naming the-Holy-One.

**23:9** For as a-slave who-is-continually-examined will-not-lack for-bruises, so also one-who-always-swears and-names [him] will-not-be-free-from sin.

**23:10** A-man-who-swears-much will-be-filled with-iniquity, and-the-scourge will-not-depart from-his-house; and if-he-offend, his-sin will-be-upon him; and if-he-ignore-it, he-sinned-doubly; and if-he-swore-in-vain, he-will-not-be-justified; for his-house will-be-filled with-calamities.

**23:11** There-is a-speech clothed-about with death; may-it-not-be-found in-the-inheritance-of-Jacob. For all-these-things will-be-far from the-godly, and they-will-not-wallow in-sins.

**23:12** Do-not-accustom your-mouth to coarse-speech, for in-it [there-is] sinful-speech.

**23:13** Remember your-father and your-mother, for you-sit in-the-midst of-great-ones; and lest you-forget yourself before-them and act-like-a-fool through-your-habit, and wish you-had-not-been-born, and curse the-day of-your-birth.

**23:14** A-man-who-is-accustomed to-reproachful-words will-not-be-disciplined all-his-days.

**23:15** Two types-of-persons multiply-sins, and a-third brings-on wrath: a-soul-burning-like-fire will-not-be-quenched until it-is-consumed; a-man-of-fornication in-the-body of-his-flesh will-not-cease until the-fire-burns-out.

**23:16** All-bread is-sweet to a-fornicator; he-will-not-tire until death.

**23:17** A-man-who-goes-astray from-his-own-bed — he-says in-his-heart, "Who-sees me? Darkness is-around-me and the-walls cover-me, and no-one sees me. What-do-I-fear? The-Most-High will-not-remember my-sins."

**23:18** His-eyes are upon human-eyes, and he-is-not-thinking that-the-eyes of-the-LORD are ten-thousands-brighter than the-sun, seeing all-the-ways of-men and looking-into secret-places.

**23:19** All-things were-known before-they-were-created, so-also after-they-were-completed.

**23:20** This-person will-be-punished in-the-streets of-the-city, and where he-did-not-suspect, he-will-be-seized.

**23:21** So also the-woman-who-abandoned her-husband and provided an-heir by a-stranger.

**23:22** For first she-was-disobedient in-the-law of-the-Most-High; and secondly she-sinned against her-husband; and thirdly she-committed-adultery-in-fornication and provided children by a-strange-man.

**23:23** She herself will-be-brought into-the-assembly, and upon her-children will-be-visitation.

**23:24** Her-children will-not-take-root, and her-branches will-not-bear-fruit.

**23:25** She-will-leave her-memory for a-curse, and her-reproach will-not-be-blotted-out.

**23:26** And those-who-are-left behind will-know that-there-is-nothing-better than the-fear of-the-LORD, and nothing-sweeter than to-attend-to the-commandments of-the-LORD.

**23:27** A-great-honor it-is to-follow after-the-LORD; and length-of-days will-be-received from-him.

**23:28** [He-who-does-these-things will-inherit praise, because the-fear-of-the-LORD leads to-life and enables one-to-sleep at-night without disturbance.]
